tooling_bug_fixed.symptom: `day-trading.py rank` died with ZeroDivisionError in Candles.__init__ on DAAQ, aborting the WHOLE ranking cycle.
tooling_bug_fixed.root_cause: A day whose bars were all interpolated leaves a header-only CSV in data/rh_bars (DAAQ_2026-08-13.csv, written by Day 8's fake-gap names). pd.concat of that empty object-dtype frame with a real one silently coerces EVERY OHLCV column to object dtype. Candles guards flat bars with np.where(rng > 0, ...), but on an object array numpy evaluates both branches in Python, so high == low raises ZeroDivisionError instead of being masked.
tooling_bug_fixed.impact: Latent since the fake-gap detector started leaving empty CSVs. It crashes on exactly the illiquid gappers C37 trades - 5 of 10 candidates today carry flat 1-min bars. A crashed ranker is worse than a wrong one: it returns nothing at all.
tooling_bug_fixed.fix: Added _coerce_ohlcv() and applied it in both load_rh_bars() and _bars_from(); forces numeric dtype and drops unparseable rows. No ranking semantics changed.

findings.title: Trigger C is structurally unusable while FLAT on a 5-minute rank cadence
findings.detail: Trigger C works now (Day 8's tooling gap is closed) and it has fired repeatedly today - RDDT bullish_engulfing+tweezer_bottom 07:12, hammer 08:02, bullish_engulfing 08:07, macd_cross_up 08:49, tweezer_bottom 08:55; BRUN tweezer_bottom 08:04; CGTL bullish_engulfing 07:10. NOT ONE was takeable. A pattern entry must be sent as a marketable limit immediately on the 1-minute close that produced it, but a 5-minute scan cadence means the signal is already 1-5 minutes old the moment we see it. Acting on it anyway would be a chase, and backfilling it would be dishonest.
findings.why_it_matters: The champion's harness ranks at the 5-minute mark and then simulates the ticket forward on 1-MINUTE bars, so in the sim Trigger C fires on a bar that is current. Live, we only look every 5 minutes, so we systematically miss the entire trigger. That is a live-vs-backtest divergence of the same class as the spread veto, and it removes one of three legal entries.
findings.fix: Once a name is the ranked TOP, poll ITS 1-minute bars every minute for a buy_set close and act on the next one - do not wait for the next 5-minute rank. The scan economy's 'no ranking while in a position' is about RANKING, not about watching the armed name.
